1→package com.cowave.search.repository.cache
     2→
     3→import com.cowave.shared.serialization.defaultJson
     4→import kotlinx.serialization.KSerializer
     5→import org.springframework.data.redis.core.RedisTemplate
     6→
     7→/**
     8→ * `ValkeyRepository`는 valkey를 DB로써 사용하는 영속성 레이어의 리포지토리입니다.
     9→ */
    10→abstract class AbstractValkeyRepository<ID, V : Any> (
    11→    private val redisTemplate: RedisTemplate<String, String>,
    12→    private val serializer: KSerializer<V>,
    13→    private val keyPrefix: String,
    14→) {
    15→
    16→    private fun serialize(value: V): String = defaultJson.encodeToString(serializer, value)
    17→
    18→    private fun deserialize(jsonString: String): V = defaultJson.decodeFromString(serializer, jsonString)
    19→
    20→    /**
    21→     * Missed keys에 대한 처리를 애플리케이션에서 주도적으로 할 수 있도록 반환에 null이 포함될 수 있습니다.
    22→     */
    23→    protected fun multiGet(ids: List<ID>): List<V?> {
    24→        return redisTemplate.opsForValue()
    25→            .multiGet(ids.toKeys())
    26→            ?.map { it?.let(::deserialize) }
    27→            ?: emptyList()
    28→    }
    29→
    30→    protected fun hashMultiGet(ids: List<ID>): List<V?> {
    31→        return redisTemplate.opsForHash<String, String>()
    32→            .multiGet(getHashKey(), ids.toFields())
    33→            .map { it?.let(::deserialize) }
    34→    }
    35→
    36→    /**
    37→     * Valkey는 DB로써 사용되므로 TTL을 가지고 있지 않어 mset이 적합합니다.
    38→     */
    39→    protected fun multiSet(keyValuePairs: Map<ID, V>) {
    40→        redisTemplate.opsForValue()
    41→            .multiSet(
    42→                keyValuePairs.map { (k, v) ->
    43→                    k.toKey() to serialize(v)
    44→                }.toMap()
    45→            )
    46→    }
    47→
    48→    protected fun hashMultiSet(keyValuePairs: Map<ID, V>) {
    49→        return redisTemplate.opsForHash<String, String>()
    50→            .putAll(
    51→                getHashKey(),
    52→                keyValuePairs.map { (k, v) ->
    53→                    k.toField() to serialize(v)
    54→                }.toMap()
    55→            )
    56→    }
    57→
    58→    protected fun getHashKey(): String = keyPrefix
    59→
    60→    protected fun ID.toKey(): String = "$keyPrefix:$this"
    61→
    62→    protected fun List<ID>.toKeys(): List<String> = this.map { it.toKey() }
    63→
    64→    protected fun ID.toField(): String = this.toString()
    65→
    66→    protected fun List<ID>.toFields(): List<String> = this.map { it.toField() }
    67→}

package com.cowave.search.repository.cache

import com.cowave.search.repository.cache.entity.BrandValkeyEntity
import com.cowave.shared.serialization.defaultJson
import io.kotest.core.spec.style.FunSpec
import io.kotest.matchers.shouldBe
import io.mockk.every
import io.mockk.mockk
import io.mockk.slot
import io.mockk.verify
import org.springframework.data.redis.core.RedisTemplate
import org.springframework.data.redis.core.ValueOperations

class BrandValkeyRepositoryTest : FunSpec({

    val redisTemplate = mockk<RedisTemplate<String, String>>()
    val valueOps = mockk<ValueOperations<String, String>>(relaxed = true)
    val repository = BrandValkeyRepository(redisTemplate)

    beforeEach {
        every { redisTemplate.opsForValue() } returns valueOps
    }

    test("getAllByIds - Valkey에 존재하는 브랜드를 조회하면 엔티티 리스트를 반환한다") {
        val brand1 = BrandValkeyEntity(id = 1L, name = "삼성")
        val brand2 = BrandValkeyEntity(id = 2L, name = "LG")

        every { valueOps.multiGet(any<Collection<String>>()) } returns listOf(
            defaultJson.encodeToString(BrandValkeyEntity.serializer(), brand1),
            defaultJson.encodeToString(BrandValkeyEntity.serializer(), brand2),
        )

        val result = repository.getAllByIds(listOf(1L, 2L))

        result.size shouldBe 2
        result[0]?.id shouldBe 1L
        result[0]?.name shouldBe "삼성"
        result[1]?.id shouldBe 2L
        result[1]?.name shouldBe "LG"
    }

    test("getAllByIds - Valkey에 존재하지 않는 키는 null로 반환한다") {
        val brand1 = BrandValkeyEntity(id = 1L, name = "삼성")

        every { valueOps.multiGet(any<Collection<String>>()) } returns listOf(
            defaultJson.encodeToString(BrandValkeyEntity.serializer(), brand1),
            null,
        )

        val result = repository.getAllByIds(listOf(1L, 999L))

        result.size shouldBe 2
        result[0]?.id shouldBe 1L
        result[1] shouldBe null
    }

    test("getAllByIds - 빈 리스트를 조회하면 빈 결과를 반환한다") {
        every { valueOps.multiGet(any<Collection<String>>()) } returns emptyList()

        val result = repository.getAllByIds(emptyList())

        result shouldBe emptyList()
    }

    test("setAll - 엔티티 리스트를 Valkey에 저장한다") {
        val brand1 = BrandValkeyEntity(id = 1L, name = "삼성")
        val brand2 = BrandValkeyEntity(id = 2L, name = "LG")
        val capturedMap = slot<Map<String, String>>()

        every { valueOps.multiSet(capture(capturedMap)) } returns Unit

        repository.setAll(listOf(brand1, brand2))

        verify { valueOps.multiSet(any()) }
        capturedMap.captured.size shouldBe 2
        capturedMap.captured.keys.any { it.contains("brand") && it.endsWith(":1") } shouldBe true
        capturedMap.captured.keys.any { it.contains("brand") && it.endsWith(":2") } shouldBe true
    }

    test("setAll - 저장된 JSON이 올바르게 직렬화된다") {
        val brand = BrandValkeyEntity(id = 42L, name = "Apple")
        val capturedMap = slot<Map<String, String>>()

        every { valueOps.multiSet(capture(capturedMap)) } returns Unit

        repository.setAll(listOf(brand))

        val storedJson = capturedMap.captured.values.first()
        val deserialized = defaultJson.decodeFromString(BrandValkeyEntity.serializer(), storedJson)
        deserialized.id shouldBe 42L
        deserialized.name shouldBe "Apple"
    }

    test("getKey - 올바른 키 포맷을 생성한다") {
        every { valueOps.multiGet(any<Collection<String>>()) } returns listOf(null)

        repository.getAllByIds(listOf(123L))

        val expectedKeys = listOf("commerce-search.search-api.cache.brand:123")
        verify { valueOps.multiGet(expectedKeys) }
    }
})

package com.cowave.search.repository.cache

import com.cowave.search.repository.cache.entity.CategoryValkeyEntity
import com.cowave.shared.serialization.defaultJson
import io.kotest.core.spec.style.FunSpec
import io.kotest.matchers.shouldBe

import io.mockk.slot
import io.mockk.verify
import org.springframework.data.redis.core.RedisTemplate
import org.springframework.data.redis.core.ValueOperations

class CategoryValkeyRepositoryTest : FunSpec({

    val redisTemplate = mockk<RedisTemplate<String, String>>()
    val valueOps = mockk<ValueOperations<String, String>>(relaxed = true)
    val repository = CategoryValkeyRepository(redisTemplate)

    beforeEach {
        every { redisTemplate.opsForValue() } returns valueOps
    }

    test("getAllByIds - Valkey에 존재하는 카테고리를 조회하면 엔티티 리스트를 반환한다") {
        val category1 = CategoryValkeyEntity(
            id = 1, name = "전자제품", depth = 1,
            idPath = "1", namePath = "전자제품", status = "USE",
        )
        val category2 = CategoryValkeyEntity(
            id = 2, name = "노트북", depth = 2,
            idPath = "1|2", namePath = "전자제품|노트북", status = "USE",
        )

        every { valueOps.multiGet(any<Collection<String>>()) } returns listOf(
            defaultJson.encodeToString(CategoryValkeyEntity.serializer(), category1),
            defaultJson.encodeToString(CategoryValkeyEntity.serializer(), category2),
        )

        val result = repository.getAllByIds(listOf(1, 2))

        result.size shouldBe 2
        result[0]?.id shouldBe 1
        result[0]?.name shouldBe "전자제품"
        result[0]?.depth shouldBe 1
        result[1]?.id shouldBe 2
        result[1]?.namePath shouldBe "전자제품|노트북"
    }

    test("getAllByIds - Valkey에 존재하지 않는 키는 null로 반환한다") {
        val category = CategoryValkeyEntity(
            id = 1, name = "전자제품", depth = 1,
